sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. A tightly cropped bust with head and upper body nearly frontal and turned mildly toward screen-left, a reserved mouth and no broad grin. A broad tan-brown woven straw hat has a rounded crown and wide, slightly sloping brim. Dark parted hair sweeps smoothly back under the hat into a short rounded rear mass; visible temple/side hair and fine dark eyebrows must remain. Gold-toned aviator glasses with brown tinted lenses cover the eyes, following the face angle. No beard or moustache is visibly present. The khaki/tan blouse or jacket has an open broad pointed collar and round brown front buttons; preserve the open clothing state, shoulders and chest crop. Adapt the mascot body with a compact round yellow head and very short broad neck transition inside the same collar style, without a long yellow stalk or white chest patch. Soft forehead, nose and cheek highlights contrast with hat-brim and chin shadows. The entire dark-charcoal upper to grey lower painted background belongs to the rectangle, without a separate card, frame, backing note or exterior cutout. Fine hat weave, glasses hinges and button markings are too small to resolve exactly; the hat, glasses, hair, brows and clothing shapes are visible.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A bust with a mildly screen-left-facing head and gaze, reserved nearly closed lips or a faint smile, and no exaggerated grin. Glossy dark-brown short-to-shoulder-length bob hair has large waves and a part near the centre, with fine dark eyebrows; no hat, eyewear or facial hair is visible. A short pale slash is visible on the screen-right forehead above the brow and narrow angled scar marks appear on the screen-right cheek below the outer eye. The dark burgundy robe/top has broad pink-red crossing lapel trim and an open neckline. The raised hand in the screen-right foreground holds a long dark cigarette holder slanting upward toward screen-right, with a pale cigarette tip and thin curling smoke behind the right side of the hair. Preserve the actual hand, holder, smoke and cloth overlap and their positions. Keep the mascot's compact round head and very short broad neck fitting that open collar, with no long yellow column or cream chest entering the neckline. Forehead, nose and cheek highlights and underchin shadows remain in the same soft painted lighting. The full dark upper and grey lower painted rectangle is the background, with no separate card, frame or note. Tiny scar texture, holder detail and hair fibres are not exactly readable; the visible scars, bob silhouette, lapels and raised cigarette-holder hand are clear.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A tight bust with a nearly frontal face and slight screen-left head/gaze direction, calm closed to faintly parted lips and no broad grin. Tall, voluminous short dark-brown hair has a high swept rolled/waved front and rounded rear silhouette; retain that hairstyle and the fine dark eyebrows. No hat, glasses, beard or moustache is visibly present. Olive/mustard-brown wrap clothing forms a broad V opening with ochre-gold crossing lapel trim and a clear overlapping front. No distinct buttons, medals or jewellery are visible. Preserve that open neckline, trim, wrap overlap, shoulders and crop while fitting a compact round mascot head to a very short broad yellow neck transition; the source neck length does not require a long yellow stalk, and no cream belly patch should appear at the collar. Bright forehead, nose, cheek and cloth-trim highlights contrast with muted chin and side shadows. The entire dark upper to grey lower painted backing remains inside the rectangular image; there is no separate paper card, note, frame or transparent exterior. Fine individual hair strands and woven trim texture are not fully readable at this source size, but the rolled hair shape, brows, wrap collar and lighting are visible.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A tightly cropped bust with head and gaze turned slightly toward screen-right and a small visible lip opening/faint smile. Glossy black hair forms a tall swept bouffant/updo with a rolled front crest and a broad gathered rear mass toward screen-left. A thin red hairpin or comb line lies diagonally along the upper screen-left rear hair, and a fine loose dark strand descends beside the screen-left temple/cheek. Preserve the visible hairstyle, red pin, loose strand and fine dark eyebrows. No hat, glasses or facial hair is visible. The rose-pink satin-like blouse has a closed standing Mandarin collar and a narrow dark central fastening/seam, with broad smooth highlights and folded shadows across the shoulders and chest. Preserve the closed collar style and fit it around the mascot's very short broad neck transition beneath a compact round head; avoid a long yellow column, pinched human neckline or cream chest patch. The forehead and cheeks are softly highlighted, with hair and underchin shade. Keep the full dark upper to grey lower painted rectangular background, without a separate card, note, frame or cutout. The hairpin's fine relief, fastening marks and individual hair fibres are too small to identify exactly; the red pin line, loose strand, blouse sheen and collar closure are visible.
